name: Library Statistics
description: Scans selected Jellyfin libraries, summarizes media formats and storage, and compares Jellyfin's merged movie and episode versions with exact paths and MediaInfo.
overview: Library statistics and merged-version duplicate analysis.

versions.changelog: Fixes repeated merged-movie groups, adds Jellyfin Helper-style donut charts, corrects unreadable select menus, clarifies library/type badges, and aligns the icon and page with Jellyfin's active theme.
First public release. Includes a Jellyfin Helper-style dashboard, selectable library exclusions, media statistics, and a merged-version duplicate finder with exact paths and per-version MediaInfo.
